path.description: Path identifies the field, section, or artifact path associated with the error.

message.description: Message is the human-readable explanation of the problem.

ErrorDetail.description: ErrorDetail describes one machine-readable validation or execution problem in a command result.

name.description: Name is the stable review dimension identifier, using lowercase alphanumeric segments separated by single hyphens.

sources.description: Sources preserves the ordered provenance of the resolved guidance. A same-name plan fragment follows its builtin or repo base source.

path.description: Path identifies the repo-relative file that supplied the resolved repo-defined or plan-scoped guidance. Built-in-only guidance omits it.

plan_path.description: PlanPath identifies the current plan whose package supplied additive guidance. Guidance with no plan-scoped fragment omits it.

description.description: Description is the concise selection guidance for controller agents.

ReviewDimensionMetadata.description: ReviewDimensionMetadata describes one dimension in the controller-facing catalog.

ok.description: OK reports whether the command succeeded.

command.description: Command is the stable command identifier for the result payload.

summary.description: Summary is the concise human-readable outcome description.

dimensions.description: Dimensions lists the discovered review dimensions available to controller agents.

warnings.description: Warnings lists non-blocking config issues that did not prevent catalog discovery.

errors.description: Errors lists hard failures that prevented the command from succeeding.

ReviewDimensionsListResult.description: ReviewDimensionsListResult is the JSON result returned by `harness review dimensions list`.

title: Review dimensions list command result
description: JSON output for `harness review dimensions list`.
